question:
The given bar graph shows the production (in million tonnes) of three different companies making hand sanitizers (Himalaya, Oriley, Boroplus) for 5 years. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5efe7115bb7c9de822ded4341c4bf6e2a0099e4949bf065f0a641e9d99113146.png] 

What is the percentage of increase in the production of sanitizers of company Himalaya from 2018 to 2020?
solution:
**Given:**

Production of sanitizers by Himalaya in 2018 = 40 million tonnes

Production of sanitizers by Himalaya in 2020 = 70 million tonnes

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Increase = frac{{Final Value} - {Initial Value}}{{Initial Value}} times 100

**Calculation:**

Percentage Increase = (70 - 40)/(40) times 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = (30)/(40) times 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = 75%

**∴ The percentage increase in the production of sanitizers by Himalaya from 2018 to 2020 is 75%.**
